The [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] '''Jedi outpost''' was one of several such [[Jedi outpost/Legends|facilities]] located across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and maintained by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==History==
Following the [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] reemergence of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] decided to increase its [[Jedi academy|academy]] program by opening a series of chapter houses and [[Jedi outpost/Legends|outposts]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to supplement the [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] outside the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="KSW" />

The academy's headmaster, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], served as [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Watchman]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld and was assisted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]] in the education of their charges. The chapter house's inaugural class had only just begun their training when the armies of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] attacked the world. During the [[Attack on Kashyyyk|battle]], many students were killed, the chapter house was destroyed, and the survivors were rounded up and imprisoned.<ref name="KSW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi outpost appears in the Jedi Destiny portion of ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''.
